ticket.title: rabbet ingest --spool: reach the local spool from the CLI
ticket.description:
IN PROGRESS. Two Gold pairs now exist in .gaugeblock/spool/outbox.jsonl (33 records, 2 gold) and nothing could read them locally: serve was the only ingress, admin stats opened a ./rabbet.db that does not exist, and no subcommand mentioned the spool.

DESIGN, transport rather than a second gate: `rabbet ingest --spool <file> --db-path <db>` reads JSON lines, deserialises SpoolEntry envelopes, and hands them to `rabbet_core::gate::process_ingest_batch` - the same four stages the HTTP endpoint runs (SHA-256 verification, PII re-scrub, structural validation, idempotent insert). A local shortcut that skipped them would let a trace into the corpus that the public path would reject.

Choices worth recording: a malformed line is counted and skipped rather than aborting the import, because one bad record must not block a corpus, but it must not vanish silently either; client_version is stamped from CARGO_PKG_VERSION so rows record which binary ingested them; db-path defaults to rabbet.db with the same RABBET_DB_PATH env override serve uses, which is the documented-answer half of the original ticket.

Verified so far: clippy -D warnings green on rabbet-cli. Test run in progress (rabbet-core pulls the full arrow/parquet stack).

verification_receipt.summary: rabbet ingest --spool <file> --db-path <db> closes the gap: local spool envelopes now reach the master store without a server, through the same four-stage gate as the HTTP path (hash verification, PII re-scrub, structural validation, idempotent insert). Verified live against the real spool: 33 records, 0 malformed, 33 accepted, 0 rejected, 0 duplicates. Downstream that was previously unreachable now runs: mine-patterns discovers 1 candidate with 2 examples, and export-parquet writes hole_filler_sft.parquet 16 rows, hole_filler_dpo.parquet 2 rows, router_sft.parquet 0 rows plus a dataset card. The DPO rows carry prompt/chosen/rejected with the scope signature and a real rejected attempt; the chosen side is still the <filled> placeholder, filed separately. Gate: clippy -D warnings and 13 tests green.

task.title: Wire the local spool into rabbet so a Gold trace can be mined without a server
task.description: A Gold trace now lands in .gaugeblock/spool/outbox.jsonl (verified: tier gold, filled_holes, verification.typecheck_passed, rejected_attempt with real code). Nothing downstream can read it locally: `rabbet admin stats` opens ./rabbet.db, which does not exist, and no rabbet subcommand references the spool or outbox at all - ingestion is only reachable through `rabbet serve`. So `mine-patterns` and `export-parquet` cannot be run from the CLI against the spool, and the DPO shard stays empty even though a Gold pair exists. Needs a `rabbet ingest --spool <path>` (or an admin equivalent) that reads SpoolEntry envelopes and writes master SQLite, plus a documented db-path default that matches where serve writes.
